1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Be7 4.Nf3 Nf6 5.Bg.strategy: Solidly supports d4 and the centre and opens the way for the f1-bishop and castling. The g5-bishop stays to press on the f6-knight, which the e7-bishop shields for now. White settles for a long manoeuvring game in which the extra space matters.
Develops the queen to the b1-h7 diagonal, where it guards c4 and backs a later e4 break. White keeps the e-pawn flexible, at the price of slower development of the kingside pieces.
1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Be7 4.Nf3 Nf6 5.Bg.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Miles Variation
